questions.question: Name three things that help people stay healthy.
questions.expected_answer: Clean water and safe toilets, healthy food, exercise and enough sleep, washing hands with soap, and health care at clinics and hospitals, such as vaccinations for babies.

questions.question: Who cares for children? Give at least three examples.
questions.expected_answer: Parents, grandparents, aunts, uncles and older brothers and sisters care for children at home. Teachers care for them at school, nurses care for them when they are ill, and neighbours look out for them.

questions.question: Name three sources of energy people use at home, and one safety rule.
questions.expected_answer: Electricity, gas, paraffin, wood, candles and solar power. A safety rule is to keep candles and paraffin stoves away from curtains and never leave them burning while you sleep.
